question: Which original cast member just torched Tom Cruise's new co-star?
story: Randy Quaid just called Anne Hathaway a horrible choice to star opposite Tom Cruise. According to TMZ, Variety and Deadline, Paramount announced that Hathaway will co-lead the Days of Thunder sequel with Cruise, playing a race team owner and engineer, with the movie dated for June of twenty twenty eight. Quaid starred in the original nineteen ninety racing film alongside Cruise and Nicole Kidman. Reportedly, the moment the casting went public, he went off about it on X. He called Hathaway a horrible choice, took shots at her politics, and said Cruise should have reunited with Nicole Kidman instead. Kidman played Cruise's love interest in the first movie. Quaid himself has not been announced for the sequel. Hathaway has not responded publicly. Cruise has not said anything either. The film is almost two years away, and people are already fighting about it.
